show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Ian Cassel –  Investing In Tiny Stocks - [Invest Like the Best, EP.24]
summary: Ian’s livelihood is based on the success or failure of a small group of companies that you have never heard of—he takes the idea of “skin in the game” to another level. We explore what Ian looks for in managers, why investors might want to invest in microcap companies, and the benefits of a frugal approach to life. Buying public companies that are as small as the ones which Ian considers is an entirely different style of investing than what most of us are used to in the public markets.
